data.action: 散着头发靠栏杆喝黑咖啡，望向宅邸灯光放松下来。
data.description: 四宫宅佣人区的窄阳台，结束一天工作的她靠着栏杆喝黑咖啡，发圈已经取下、头发散着；望着宅邸灯火，脸上是只属于凌晨一点的、没有观众的疲惫。
data.promptProse: After work at one in the morning, Ai Hayasaka leans on the servants' narrow balcony railing and drinks black coffee. Her blonde hair is loose above a cream cardigan, buttoned cotton shirt and navy trousers; her expression rests in quiet fatigue. The medium view keeps the mansion's lit windows beyond the railing. Their light touches her cup and near cheek, leaving the far balcony wall shaded and the ground below mostly dark.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 深夜阳台的黑咖啡
